main_text.p: רִמְתְּרַפֵּא[?] Qui remissus est, Proverb. 18.9. Imperativ.
אִתְרַפּוּ[?] Obstupescite, Jesa.29.9. לֹא נִרְפֶּה[?] Non remissus reddatur, ad Hebr.12.3.5.
יִפְּן[?] Syr. Remissus, dissolutus, ad Hebr.12.16.
רפח רְפִיחַ[?] Ch. Nomē proprium loci, Num.34.15. T.H.
רפל רוּפִילִין[?] Ch. Principes, duces, comites, Ruth.1.2. Esth.9.12. Reg. Gratiosi, Elias dicit רְפִיל[?] esse Secundum à Rege. Transl. Judæor. Germ. Graven.
רפן יְפָן[?] Syr. Rephan, nomen Idoli, Act.7.43.
רפם Ch. Calcare, Idem quod רַמַּם[?]. Ithpahel Futur. וְיִתְרַפְּסוּן[?] Et conculcabuntur, dejicientur, deprimentur labia tua, Eccles.12.4. Regia, Et remittetur, ac si esset וְיִתְרַפּוּן[?].
רפסת רפסא Ch. Calcatio, conculcatio, Ezech.26.10.
רפף Ithpah. אִתְרוֹפֵף[?] Chald. Tremere, contremiscere. Partic. מִתְרוֹפְּפִין[?] Contremiscent, Jobi 9.6.
Syr. Ictus, Nutus oculi: [illegible, ~8 letters] Quasi ictu oculi, 1.ad Corinth.15.52. Græc. ἐν ῥιπῇ ὀφθαλμοῦ.
רפק Raphka, Rebecca, conjux Isaaci. מִרְפְּקִי מַרְפְּקִין[?] Ch. Axillæ. Vide in רבק.
רפש Syr. Pala, ventilabrū, [illegible, ~6 letters] Cujus ventilabrū in manu sua, Matth.3.12. Luc.3.17.
רפת Syr. Erodi, exedi, Act.12.23. Vide notas D. Tremell. & Francis. Junii.
ריפתא Ch. Panis, תלתא סליון דריפתא Tres corbes panis, Genes.40.16. in Targ. Hierof. Jonath. רפתא.

page.notes: The Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee forms are copied as far as legible; those marked [?] are doubtful. Two Syriac/Hebrew passages in the entries for "Ictus" and "Pala" are too small to read letter by letter and are marked illegible. The Greek in the "Ictus" entry is approximate. The headwords at the left margin are large bold Hebrew letters, printed as entry heads.
